FOREIGN EXCHANGE REGULATIONS ACT, 1947
FOREIGN EXCHANGE REGULATIONS
ACT, 1947
(Period for which all offences
punishable under
the section 23 shall be
cognizable
and non-bailable.)
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary, Part II,
8th July, 2011]
S.R.O.
680(I)/2011, dated 7-7-2011.---In exercise of the powers conferred by
subsection (2) of section 23 of the Foreign Exchange Regulations Act, 1947 (VII
of 1947), the Federal Government is pleased to declare the period ending the
30th June, 2012 to be the period for which all offences punishable under the
said section 23 shall be cognizable and non-bailable.
